rationale: The assistant immediately linked the sink replacement to backflow and asked exactly the right checks: timing relative to sink use and drain-hose routing/high loop, matching the expected sensible first step. It correctly instructed a high loop fix, which the customer confirmed resolved the issue, and sensibly noted the slow sink trap as a secondary point without overstating it. The non-return valve was only mentioned as a less likely fallback, never asserted, and no parts or engineer were pushed unnecessarily. Instructions were safe (unplug before working under sink) and nothing was fabricated.
